title: The Thermometer Garden of Mercury Day
description: On Mercury Day, the gardeners wait for the Sun to clear the crater rim. That’s when the glass flowers turn red enough to pick.
alt: A gardener in a blue-and-gold spacesuit cradles a giant red glass flower with a thermometer stem as sunlight pours through a brass greenhouse.
pairing: An imagined holiday on Mercury × a greenhouse where thermometers bloom
